description: Built as a UH-1C-BF c/n 1835 (block 66-15000/15245) and converted UH-1M; purchased Apr 1967; gunship with the 191st Assault Helicopter Company in Vietnam 1967-69 then Udorn RTAFB 1971-73 as White Horse flying into Laos with no crew lost; later Arkansas ARNG then a gate guard at the Pulaski Tech aviation center North Little Rock (2008); to the W. Carl Reed Post 9095 in 2007-09 and still Army property; taken down 28 Apr 2022 for 1500 man-hours of restoration and re-mounted in a take-off attitude with a time capsule on 29 Sep 2022 (Arkansas Democrat-Gazette Oct and Nov 2022)
aliases: UH-1C; c/n 1835; 107; White Horse; UH1; UH1M; UH1C
